messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: structured multi-scale hexagonal packing

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A configuration of 13 points arranged as a two-scale hexagonal lattice—one central point surrounded by a hexagon of six points at radius r₁ and an outer hexagon of six points at radius r₂=2r₁ rotated 30° relative to the inner hexagon, scaled to fit within [0,1]²—achieves a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/54. The minimum area arises from three collinear-spaced adjacent points on a single hexagonal lattice line forming a degenerate-near triangle, and this value is optimal because any perturbation reducing the outer scale forces at least one inner-outer triple closer together."}
